sections.heading: Procedure — read a gauge in five steps
steps: Identify the symbol on the dial face.
Read the unit printed under the needle.
Compare the needle against the marked range.
Note whether the tell-tale lamp is lit.
Write the value and the unit in your report.

sections.body: A note callout sits on a neutral tinted card with an info glyph. Use it for side remarks that do not interrupt the flow.
sections.heading: Callout — note

sections.body: A tip callout uses the green primary container. Use it for a faster or better way to do the task.
sections.heading: Callout — tip

sections.body: A caution callout uses the amber warning tint. Use it when a mistake costs time or a retry.

sections.body: A danger callout uses the red error container. Use it only when a mistake can hurt a person or destroy equipment.

sections.body: In the pack JSON, put locators under media/ inside the zip. A section may list gallery, images, audio, video, links, math, and plots together. A single file is a gallery of one. Many files are a gallery. Live plots are JSON points; pack PNGs are extra stills.
